from: Loop City wool bands v3 · step 17, Extract parcels
rules: The tensor field runs on the urban parcels only: site.rings is their outline.
A park stays a park: it is listed in parks, drawn solid, and the tensor field must not run on it.
Farming, protected and open parcels are not taken: they stay as they are.
Road classes: M boundary highway (the cell edge), A primary road, B A road, C B road; width is the true width in metres.
